# Sachith Shetty

> This is a personal blog where I write about programming, technology, and other topics I'm interested in.

## Content

The blog contains articles on various technical topics including:

- Project showcases
- Technical demos
- Personal thoughts on technology

## Navigation

- Home: index.html
- Articles: articles.html
- Tags: tags.html
- Sitemap: sitemap.xml
- Atom feed: atom.xml

## Markdown

Markdown source files are available alongside their rendered HTML pages. Replace
the `.html` extension with `.md` to access the source:

- https://shettysach.github.io/index.html → https://shettysach.github.io/index.md
- https://shettysach.github.io/linear_and_affine/index.html → https://shettysach.github.io/linear_and_affine/index.md

Generated pages, such as the article and tag indexes, do not have Markdown sources.
